description: The intake approval policy of spaarke-intake-pipeline-r1 task 017 (FR-11; owner decision 2026-11-28: intake approval runs on the Decide lane). A Decide-lane Existence rule over the service request: it holds while the request's intake stage is Awaiting approval (sprk_intakestage 100000003). Only the intake pipeline sets sprk_intakestage, so outbound inquiries (sprk_direction Outbound, the same table) never match: their stage is empty. The intake run raises the evaluation itself (the IntakeAwaitingApproval Signal trigger); the nightly pass is the backstop, and a stage that moves on without a decision closes the Signal (ConditionCleared). The plan offers approve-intake and reject-intake, exactly one of which is taken; the commit route refuses dismissal and Also resolve for this plan, and the policy never counts toward suppression (D-11). workType is null on purpose: the Console Decide lane has no approval card yet, so the item shows under Other until task 019 adds the work type. Applied to Dataverse by scripts/intake/Apply-IntakeApprovalPolicy.ps1 (which runs scripts/Apply-DoLanePolicies.ps1 -DefinitionPath config/intake-approval.policies.json; an idempotent upsert by the fixed ids below). The policy is created with sprk_enabled = No; the owner turns it on, and the script never changes sprk_enabled on an existing row. A version row is immutable once published (FR-49, D-14): a changed body, plan or template is a NEW version entry, never an edit of this one.
